source: Génère une grande scène de show en 3D avec un dispositif d'éclairage dynamique, des écrans géants, des effets de fumée, une immense estrade et une musique de fond stylée et dynamique, avec un système de contrôle interactif.

answers.ask: What style should the venue read as - a modern arena concert, a festival main stage, a nightclub?
answers.answer: Le lieu doit être une scène principale de festival moderne, avec une esthétique spectaculaire et dynamique.

answers.ask: Is there an audience area with a defined capacity, or is the stage the whole build?
answers.answer: Ajoutez une zone de public simple devant l’estrade, sans capacité définie ; la scène reste l’élément central du build.

answers.ask: Who operates the interactive control system - is it a physical console in the world, or a screen menu?
answers.answer: Le système se contrôle via une console physique interactive placée sur le côté de la scène.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: What style should the venue read as - a modern arena concert, a festival main stage, a nightclub? A: Le lieu doit être une scène principale de festival moderne, avec une esthétique spectaculaire et dynamique.
- [author] shape — Q: Is there an audience area with a defined capacity, or is the stage the whole build? A: Ajoutez une zone de public simple devant l’estrade, sans capacité définie ; la scène reste l’élément central du build.
- [author] goal — Q: Who operates the interactive control system - is it a physical console in the world, or a screen menu? A: Le système se contrôle via une console physique interactive placée sur le côté de la scène.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a large 3D modern festival main stage with a spectacular, dynamic appearance. Place an immense raised stage as the central rear focal point, with giant screens, extensive dynamic lighting rigs, and visible smoke-effect emitters integrated around it. Spread one simple audience area directly in front of the stage with no fixed capacity or tiered seating. Place one physical interactive control console at the side of the stage, clearly accessible without displacing the audience. Compose every sightline toward the stage and keep the screens, lighting, smoke, audience floor, and side console visible in one dramatic isometric view.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Entertainment.

## Shape and preset
Use `venue-stage`, Stage and Audience, because every audience sightline faces one central performance platform. It matches the Performance Venue preset, retaining the gathering floor and stage-facing arrival while dropping tiered bleachers because the author requested a simple audience area.

## Config requirements
Use `social-hub` for the simple standing audience floor, `spawn-first-reveal` for an arrival oriented toward the immense stage, and `zone-graphics` for concentrated giant-screen, dynamic-lighting, reflection, and smoke-effect clusters. Add the physical side-stage control console as a scene-specific prop.

## Layout requirements
Place one `spawn-first-reveal` SpawnZone at the back of the audience area, facing the stage. Place one free-text TriggerZone at the physical control console on the stage side, aligned to the console geometry and outside the main audience circulation. Lighting changes, screen content, smoke cues, interactive controls, and background music are runtime systems rather than additional layout.

## Layout components
The build contains one immense raised main stage, giant screens, lighting trusses, smoke emitters, one simple flat audience zone in front, one rear audience entry, and one side-stage control console. The stage anchors the rear of the frame; the audience floor fills the foreground; the console remains visible and accessible along one side. Venue edges form a simple event boundary.

## Render order
Render `isometric` first and treat it as authoritative, because the spectacular stage composition, effect placement, screen scale, and audience sightlines define the scene.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use the medium scale band because the large stage and audience floor must fit while the control console and effect fixtures remain legible. The theme is a modern festival main stage with spectacular dynamic production design. Use baseline `P0`: the stage and audience occupy one unobstructed venue surface with no tiered seating, enterable backstage area, or separate map.
